parrafo_1.es: Sivira Mobile Pet Grooming es un servicio de peluqueria canina a domicilio que atiende Fort Lauderdale, FL. Llegamos hasta tu casa para banar, cortar y arreglar a tu perro con el estilo que ves en nuestras fotos.
parrafo_1.en: Sivira Mobile Pet Grooming is a mobile dog grooming service serving Fort Lauderdale, FL. We come to your home to bathe, trim and style your dog, with the finished look you see in our photos.

parrafo_2.es: En nuestras resenas de Google, los duenos repiten lo mismo: paciencia real con perros nerviosos o con condiciones de salud, puntualidad y un trato que hace que su perro se emocione al ver la van llegar.
parrafo_2.en: The same things come up again and again in our Google reviews: real patience with nervous dogs or dogs with health conditions, punctuality, and care that makes dogs excited to see the van pull up.

texto.es: Nos cuentas la raza de tu perro y que necesita (bano, corte, estilo) y coordinamos el dia de la visita.
texto.en: Tell us your dog's breed and what they need, a bath, a cut, a full style, and we will set up a day for the visit.

texto.es: Nuestra van llega a tu direccion en Fort Lauderdale y alrededores, sin que tengas que manejar ni esperar en una sala llena de otros animales.
texto.en: Our van pulls up to your address across Fort Lauderdale and the surrounding area, no driving and no waiting room full of other animals.

texto.es: Banamos, cortamos y arreglamos a tu perro ahi mismo, con calma y a su propio ritmo, igual que en las fotos.
texto.en: We bathe, trim and style your dog right there, at a calm, patient pace, just like the finished looks in our photos.

titulo.en: Your dog looks great, no stress

texto.es: Te devolvemos a tu perro limpio y arreglado, sin el estres del traslado ni de una peluqueria llena de gente y otros animales.
texto.en: You get your dog back clean and styled, without the stress of a car ride or a salon full of people and other animals.

nota.es: Cada servicio se cotiza segun la raza, el pelaje y lo que necesite tu perro. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Pricing is quoted based on your dog's breed, coat and the service needed. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Bano, corte y acabado con panuelo o moño, igual al look terminado que ves en nuestras fotos.
texto.en: Bath, haircut and a finished look with a bandana or bow, just like the styled photos you see here.

texto.es: Bano a domicilio con cepillado para mantener el pelaje limpio y sin nudos entre cortes.
texto.en: A mobile bath with a full brush-out to keep the coat clean and tangle-free between cuts.

titulo.es: Corte de unas y limpieza de oidos

texto.es: Corte de unas y limpieza de oidos durante la misma visita, sin necesidad de otra cita.
texto.en: Nail trimming and ear cleaning handled during the same visit, no extra appointment needed.

texto.es: Cortes adaptados a la raza de tu perro, del caniche al cavalier, con atencion a cada detalle.
texto.en: Cuts adapted to your dog's breed, from poodles to cavaliers, with attention to every detail.

pie.es: No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llamanos igual, te orientamos segun tu perro.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us anyway and we will guide you based on your dog.

items.quote: Raphael is dedicated and gentle with my Cavalier. He takes special care as she has heart issues. I only trust him with her. Raphael also is responsive and punctual.

Rafael with Sivira Mobile Grooming has been grooming my pup Bailey for nearly a year and he is incredibly professional and very talented as a groomer. Bailey always is excited to see the van. Keep up the great work my friend!
I have been using sivira grooming for about three years now and the care and attention to detail is AMAZING.
